_provenance.source: ISTAT comune boundaries (openpolis/geojson-italy) dissolved per official MASAF disciplinare comune lists
_provenance.authority: ISTAT (comune geometry) — comune membership per MASAF disciplinari di produzione
_provenance.method: comune-union (dissolve) — comune-level approximation, not parcel-level; interior rings dropped
_provenance.note: Sicily has no official delimited-zone GIS; footprints built from disciplinare comune lists. Etna=20 comuni (Catania); Cerasuolo di Vittoria DOCG=14 comuni (Ragusa/Catania/Caltanissetta); Marsala=Trapani province minus Pantelleria/Favignana/Alcamo.
